concepts.label: cbbackupmgr merge sub-command
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - a per-sub-command concept distinct from the whole tool:cbbackupmgr, needed because this page (and cbbackupmgr-merge.md, this batch) states behavior specific to the merge sub-command rather than the tool as a whole

concepts.label: Periodic Merge strategy
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the page's own recommended strategy name, taking daily incrementals and merging weekly instead of ever taking a second full backup

concepts.label: Full/Incremental Approach strategy
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - sibling strategy to Periodic Merge; creates a fresh repository (and therefore a fresh full backup) on a schedule instead of merging

concepts.label: Full Backup Only strategy
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the third, most cluster-intensive strategy the page names; every backup is a fresh full backup in a fresh repository

relations.subject: backup:periodic-merge-strategy
relations.evidence: The periodic merge strategy takes full advantage the fact that cbbackupmgr only takes incremental backups as well as its ability to merge incremental backup.

relations.subject: backup:full-backup
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - promoted; subject is the statement/practice to avoid (repeated full cluster backups), object is the alternative the page recommends instead (incremental backups plus merge)
relations.evidence: By always taking incremental backups and merging at a later time, we can completely avoid full cluster backups.

relations.subject: backup:full-incremental-strategy
relations.evidence: In this strategy we don't use the merge command, but instead rely on creating a new backup repository each week on Sunday.

notable_absence.finding: This page recommends the merge-based Periodic Merge strategy as the default without repeating that the merge command it depends on is Enterprise-only (stated on cbbackupmgr-merge.md: 'The merge command is an Enterprise Edition command'). A Community Edition reader following this page's top recommendation has no warning here that the strategy is unavailable to them; they would only discover the gate on a different page.

cross_product_finding: The Capella twin caution for this round's other module (javascript-udfs) does not apply here in the other direction: this page has no Capella twin at all - Capella's own backup pages describe a UI-driven Cloud Backup with a Full/Scheduled/Incremental vocabulary of its own (backup:full-backup / backup:incremental-backup / backup:scheduled-backup, already in the extraction layer from cloud/clusters/backup-restore.json) but never describe a Periodic Merge, Full/Incremental Approach, or Full Backup Only strategy, nor a merge command, because Capella manages the schedule/retention/merge decisions itself rather than exposing them as an administrator-chosen strategy the way this page does.
